title: RFID Tag Wholesale — Distributor Volume Pricing
summary: Proud Tek supplies RFID tags at wholesale pricing for distributors, resellers, system integrators and large-volume end users. Our wholesale program covers UHF RAIN RFID tags, NFC tags, HF labels, special-purpose industrial tags and wearable tags. With tiered pricing, stock and made-to-order supply modes, dedicated account management and a white-label program that already serves 100+ brands.
heroPoints: For procurement teams, wholesale pricing tiers — aggressive volume discounts at 5K, 10K, 50K, 100K and 1M+ piece levels across all tag categories.
Full RFID tag catalog. UHF inlays, NFC stickers, on-metal tags, laundry tags, asset labels, wristband tags, cable ties, and 50+ other form factors available for wholesale.
Private label and white label. We supply unbranded or with your brand identity on tags, packaging, datasheets and certificates of compliance.

sections.title: Why wholesalers choose Proud Tek as their RFID tag supplier
sections.intro: Proud Tek has supplied distributors and resellers since 2008, and wholesale programs now ship to partners in more than 50 countries, with the heaviest concentration in Europe and the Americas. The economics below are why distributors consolidate on a factory partner instead of juggling trading companies: the middleman margin disappears, the catalog is wide enough to quote whole projects, and the documentation survives customer audits.

before: Limited product range from fragmented suppliers
after: Factory-direct pricing with full wholesale margins
100+ tag form factors from one source
Private-label packaging at no extra charge above 10K
Dedicated account manager and safety stock program

bullets: Factory-direct wholesale eliminates one or two middlemen from the supply chain. Distributors and resellers get manufacturer pricing that leaves healthy margins for their own sales channels.

Broad product catalog means you can source NFC stickers, UHF inlays, industrial hard tags, laundry tags, wristband tags and specialty tags from a single vendor. Simplifying procurement and reducing vendor management overhead.
Dedicated wholesale account managers handle pricing, lead times, quality documentation and logistics coordination so you have a single point of contact for your entire RFID tag supply chain.
Private-label packaging lets you sell under your own brand. We supply tags in your branded boxes, with your datasheets, and your company name on compliance documents and test reports.
Safety stock and consignment programs keep popular SKUs ready for immediate dispatch, reducing your lead times to 1-3 days for fast-moving products.

sections.title: Wholesale RFID tag categories
sections.intro: One vendor covering every category is the point of the program: a distributor can quote NFC stickers, UHF inlays and laundry tags on a single purchase order, with one freight booking and one documentation pack. All five categories below ship from the same two Shenzhen factories, so mixed orders consolidate cleanly.
bullets: UHF RAIN RFID: wet inlays, dry inlays, paper labels, on-metal hard tags, hang tags, garment tags, and specialty labels for retail, logistics and industrial applications.
NFC/HF RFID: NFC stickers (NTAG 213/215/216), NFC wet inlays, anti-metal NFC tags, NFC epoxy tags, NFC tamper-evident tags (NTAG 424 DNA), and ICODE SLIX library tags.
Industrial hard tags: laundry tags (PPS, silicone, textile), cable tie tags, bolt tags, nail tags, ceramic high-temperature tags, and chemical-resistant drum tags.
LF RFID — 125 kHz animal ear tags, glass capsule tags, and key fob tags for legacy access control and animal identification.
Wearable RFID: silicone wristbands, fabric wristbands, NFC rings, and watch-strap tags for events, healthcare and fitness applications.

sections.title: Stock program vs made-to-order production
sections.intro: Wholesale runs on two supply modes. Fast-moving SKUs sit in safety stock, held against your forecast and released on call-off; custom-printed, encoded and specialty items are made to order. Most distributors run both — stock for the running catalog, made-to-order for project business — and the order paperwork tells you which mode each line item is on.
bullets: Safety stock and consignment: popular SKUs held for 1-3 day dispatch, with bonded warehouse storage available for distributor safety-stock programs.
Call-off cadence: distributors typically hold a 30-90 day buffer at our warehouse and see call-off shipments within 3-5 business days of release authorization.
Made-to-order: pilot orders of 5,000-50,000 pieces ship in two to three weeks once artwork and encoding files are locked; recurring reorders move on a 3-4 week cycle.
Scheduled releases: place one large order at the best volume tier and receive delivery in multiple batches — weekly, monthly, or on-demand call-off from our warehouse.
Blanket agreements: distributors committing to annual volumes get fixed pricing at the committed tier regardless of individual shipment size.

sections.title: Private label and white-label program
sections.intro: Most wholesale partners resell under their own brand, so white-label supply is the default rather than an add-on. We currently white-label for more than 100 brands across 50+ countries and maintain strict confidentiality between competing customers — your customers see your brand at every touchpoint, including the compliance paperwork they audit.
bullets: Your brand on the product, packaging, datasheets and compliance documentation, with no private-label surcharge on orders above 10,000 pieces.
Packaging formats: bulk poly bag, individual sleeve, retail blister or fully custom branded box, packed for resale distribution.
Confidentiality: NDAs are available on request, and we do not disclose customer programs or cross-sell between competing resellers in the same market.
Branded collateral: we prepare branded product images and specification sheets you can publish on your own website and marketing materials.

Documentation that survives audits: RoHS / REACH declarations, radio-conformity certificates (FCC / CE as applicable) and functional test reports ship with every order, issued under your branding where required while remaining traceable to the production lot.

sections.title: Reseller margin economics
sections.intro: We publish margin benchmarks because distributors who price correctly stay in business and reorder — a partner who marks up 10% and churns helps nobody. The figures below come from our distributor margin guide and reflect 2026 market norms; actual results vary with vertical depth and how much service you attach to the product.

callout.label: Deep dive
callout.text: Tier-by-tier math — including value-added service pricing, annual contract structures and RFID-as-a-service models — is in our distributor margin guide.

bullets: Healthy gross margin runs 25-45% on standard tags and 35-60% on custom OEM programs — the spread reflects whether the reseller adds technical value or just marks up.
Markup norms: 1.4-2.0× factory cost on standard tags and 1.6-2.5× on custom programs; below 1.4× rarely covers sales, support and inventory cost.
Services are the profit engine: encoding, programming and kitting carry 60-80% gross margin, typically charged at $0.05-0.50 per tag on top of the product price.
Local stock premium: inventory that ships to your customers in 2-5 days commands a 15-25% premium over factory lead times for urgent demand.
Recurring structures: distributors moving 50-70% of revenue into annual blanket and managed-inventory structures see 8-15 percentage points of margin lift from amortized acquisition cost.

sections.title: Qualifying as a wholesale partner
sections.intro: Onboarding is deliberately light: we qualify partners on application fit and reorder potential, not paperwork volume. Expect a quotation within one business day (Monday-Friday, GMT+8), samples in the first week, and a named account manager from the first order onward.
bullets: Free samples with RF test data before the first order, so you and your end customer can validate tags against the target reader infrastructure.
Payment terms: pilot orders run 50% deposit, 50% before shipment by T/T; established distributors move to open-account Net 30/60 terms, with LC support at higher volumes.
Dedicated account manager as the single point of contact for pricing, lead times, quality documentation and logistics across all categories.
Logistics options: DHL / FedEx / EMS express, air freight, or sea freight LCL and FCL on standard FOB Shenzhen / Yantian incoterms, with full export documentation handled by our team.

faq.question: What are the minimum quantities for wholesale RFID tag pricing?
faq.answer: Wholesale pricing begins at 5,000 pieces per SKU. Tier pricing improves at 10K, 50K, 100K and 1M+ levels. For distributors committing to annual volumes, we offer blanket pricing agreements with the best rates regardless of individual shipment size.

faq.question: Do you offer private-label RFID tags for resellers?
faq.answer: Yes. We supply RFID tags with your brand name on the product, packaging, datasheets and compliance documentation. We can also host your branded product images and specifications for your website and marketing materials. There is no additional charge for private labeling on orders above 10,000 pieces.

faq.question: Can wholesale orders be split into multiple shipments?
faq.answer: Yes. We support scheduled release shipments where you place a single large order for the best volume pricing but receive delivery in multiple batches on your preferred schedule. Weekly, monthly, or on-demand call-off from our warehouse.

faq.question: What margin should a reseller plan for on RFID tags?
faq.answer: Industry norm is 1.4-2.0× factory cost on standard tags (28-50% gross margin) and 1.6-2.5× on custom programs. The stronger lever is attached services: encoding, programming and kitting carry 60-80% margin at $0.05-0.50 per tag. Our distributor margin guide breaks the math down by vertical and product class.

faq.question: Should we hold local stock or drop-ship from your factory?
faq.answer: Most distributors do both, by SKU. Drop-ship works for commodity tags where price matters more than speed; local stock earns a 15-25% premium on urgent-need items that ship in 2-5 days. Our safety-stock and scheduled-release programs are designed to feed a local-stock model without tying up your working capital in full production runs.

faq.question: What payment terms are available for wholesale partners?
faq.answer: Standard pilot terms are 50% deposit, 50% before shipment, paid by T/T. Established distributors and brand-owner programs move onto open-account terms (Net 30 / Net 60) after the first one or two orders, with LC support for higher volumes. We do not require Western Union or personal-account payment routes.
